sections.text: مقدمة

This documents outlines the equipment inspection procedure I1, which must be 
 performed every six month as indicated by M6 in the 
 title block.

تُستخدم هذه المضخة لدفع مياه التبريد عبر المبادلات الحرارية حتى تبرد 
 المعدات المساعدة.

The first draft Initiated by eng. Yasser Soliman Rakha, tested by eng. Abed 
 Allah Ebrahim, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng Abouda Elbana, 
 accepted by General manager eng. Mohamed Hussein, and approved by eng: Fawzy 
 Sobhy Ismaiel Abu Sultan power station head sector.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS Coordinator and 
 certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman admin. and financial 
 inspection & quality control general director and supervisor of EDEPC 
 inspection and quality control head sector.

sections.text: Starting of pump
Check the direction of rotation of pump.

Open the cooling water to each gland
and the quantity of water is sufficient.

Check the level of oil in constant level 
 oilier for thrust bearing.
